text: {character:???}Wake up... Wake up... Wake up... Washizu…
{character:Iwao Washizu}Who the hell has the audacity?!!!!
The madman has awakened. Just as he's about to lose everything, the man known as the Lord of Mahjong Hell has returned to the final battlefield with his extreme obsession.
He has yet to fully awaken from his dream, and he can still see in his mind those two strange figures.
He can still vaguely remember that the two seemed to have claimed to be gods...
Kekeke... I guess your age is finally catching up with you. Washizu, no god will appear before you.
{character:Shigeru Akagi}The only god that will stand before you is the grim reaper.

{character:Iwao Washizu}Ka... Kakaka! You're not wrong, you know! The same goes for you, Akagi! Such a nonsensical dream could never actually happen. Tonight, the only thing that awaits us is the grim reaper!
